cue: Initial transistor-level topology for LM358B proposed by EDAI (FLAN-T5 + rules: none)
lesson: Start from blueprint 'EDAI_LM358B': GF180MCU 6V transistor-level op-amp sized by gm/ID (ngspice pre-check 8/11 specs). Keep the .include model line; devices use nfet_06v0_bsim0 / pfet_06v0_bsim0.

evidence.table: NM1 D=VB1 G=VB1 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM2 D=VB2 G=VB2 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM3 D=OUT G=N1 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM4 D=N2 G=VB2 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM5 D=N1 G=N3 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM6 D=N3 G=N3 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM7 D=N4 G=N5 S=VSS B=VSS ; NM8 D=N5 G=N5 S=VSS B=VSS ; PM1 D=OUT G=N4 S=VDD B=VDD ; PM2 D=VB1 G=N4 S=VDD B=VDD ; PM3 D=N1 G=IN1 S=N6 B=VDD ; PM4 D=N3 G=IN2 S=N6 B=VDD ; PM5 D=N6 G=N4 S=VDD B=VDD ; PM6 D=N4 G=N4 S=VDD B=VDD ; PM7 D=N5 G=N2 S=VDD B=VDD ; PM8 D=N2 G=N2 S=VDD B=VDD ; PM9 D=VB2 G=N2 S=N7 B=VDD ; R1 P=N7 N=VDD ; C1 P=OUT N=N1

EDAI_LM358B.description: EDAI FLAN-T5 initial op-amp core for LM358B (GF180 6V)

.include "gf180_6v_typical.lib"
.subckt LM358B IN1_P IN1_N IN2_P IN2_N OUT1 OUT2 V_P V_N NC

MNM2 VB2 VB2 V_N V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=15u l=2u

MNM4 N2 VB2 V_N V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=15u l=2u
MNM5 N1 N3 V_N V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=7.29u l=2u
MNM6 N3 N3 V_N V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=7.4u l=2u
MNM7 N4 N5 V_N V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=14.9u l=2u
MNM8 N5 N5 V_N V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=8.75u l=2u
MPM1 OUT1 N4 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=100u l=2u m=20
MPM2 VB1 N4 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=91.3u l=2u
MPM3 N1 IN1_P N6 V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=39u l=1u
MPM4 N3 IN1_N N6 V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=39.6u l=1u
MPM5 N6 N4 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=67.5u l=2u
MPM6 N4 N4 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=68.6u l=2u
MPM7 N5 N2 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=40.2u l=2u
MPM8 N2 N2 V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=30.1u l=2u
MPM9 VB2 N2 N7 V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=31.8u l=1u
R1 N7 V_P 10k
C1 OUT1 N1 1p
MSU_MS1 SU_SX V_N V_P V_P pfet_06v0_bsim0 w=0.5u l=20u
MSU_MS2 N2 SU_SX V_N V_N nfet_06v0_bsim0 w=2u l=1u

.ends LM358B
